title: feat: P0 SpecBridge & Core Protocol Infrastructure
body:
Implements the P0 foundational bridge layers that enable ObjectUI to render enterprise interfaces from `@objectstack/spec` JSON metadata. Protocol alignment moves from ~20% to ~55%.

## SpecBridge (`packages/react/src/spec-bridge/`)

Registry-based transformer: spec JSON → ObjectUI `SchemaNode` tree.

- **ListViewBridge** — `ListViewSchema` → `object-grid` (column mapping, selection, pagination, density, grouping, row colors)
- **FormViewBridge** — `FormViewSchema` → `object-form` (sections with 1-4 column layout, field widget overrides)
- **PageBridge** — `PageSchema` → `page` (16 page types, regions, all 29 `PageComponentType` mappings)
- **DashboardBridge** — `DashboardSchema` → `dashboard` (header, global filter bar, widget grid)

```typescript
const bridge = new SpecBridge({ user, objectDefs });
const node = bridge.transformListView(specJson); // → SchemaNode for SchemaRenderer
```

## Expression Engine in SchemaRenderer (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`)

SchemaRenderer now evaluates `visible`/`visibleOn`/`hidden`/`hiddenOn`/`disabled`/`disabledOn` — previously these fields were stripped but never applied.

```json
{ "type": "button", "visible": "${data.role === 'admin'}", "disabled": "${data.status === 'locked'}" }
```

## ActionEngine (`packages/core/src/actions/ActionEngine.ts`)

Declarative action dispatch layer on top of existing `ActionRunner`:

- Event → action mapping with conditional dispatch
- Location-based filtering (`list_toolbar`, `record_header`, etc.)
- Keyboard shortcut registry with key normalization
- Bulk operations (parallel/sequential, continueOnError)

## ViewDataProvider (`packages/core/src/data-scope/ViewDataProvider.ts`)

Resolves `@objectstack/spec` `ViewData` discriminated union via pluggable `DataFetcher`:

- `provider: 'object'` — metadata-driven (object name → records + field metadata)
- `provider: 'api'` — custom REST endpoints (handles `records`/`data`/`items` response shapes)
- `provider: 'value'` — static data passthrough

## Test coverage

75 new tests (27 SpecBridge, 14 expression, 19 ActionEngine, 15 ViewDataProvider). Full suite: 4,885 tests, 0 regressions.
